objects.constraint public.workflow_definitions.w: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id, id, revision) REFERENCES workflow_revisions(organization_id, workflow_id, revision) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES auth.organization(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (owner_user_id) REFERENCES auth."user"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
objects.constraint public.workflow_revisions.wor:
CHECK ((
CASE
    WHEN (jsonb_typeof((definition -> 'actions'::text)) = 'array'::text) THEN (((jsonb_array_length((definition -> 'actions'::text)) >= 1) AND (jsonb_array_length((definition -> 'actions'::text)) <= 1)) AND ((((definition -> 'actions'::text) -> 0) ->> 'type'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['email'::text, 'webhook'::text])))
    ELSE false
END IS TRUE))

CHECK ((
CASE
    WHEN (jsonb_typeof((definition -> 'conditions'::text)) = 'array'::text) THEN ((jsonb_array_length((definition -> 'conditions'::text)) <= 5) AND ((((definition -> 'conditions'::text) -> 0) IS NULL) OR ((((definition -> 'conditions'::text) -> 0) ->> 'field'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['event_type'::text, 'booking_source'::text, 'answer'::text, 'location_kind'::text, 'guest_count'::text]))) AND ((((definition -> 'conditions'::text) -> 1) IS NULL) OR ((((definition -> 'conditions'::text) -> 1) ->> 'field'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['event_type'::text, 'booking_source'::text, 'answer'::text, 'location_kind'::text, 'guest_count'::text]))) AND ((((definition -> 'conditions'::text) -> 2) IS NULL) OR ((((definition -> 'conditions'::text) -> 2) ->> 'field'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['event_type'::text, 'booking_source'::text, 'answer'::text, 'location_kind'::text, 'guest_count'::text]))) AND ((((definition -> 'conditions'::text) -> 3) IS NULL) OR ((((definition -> 'conditions'::text) -> 3) ->> 'field'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['event_type'::text, 'booking_source'::text, 'answer'::text, 'location_kind'::text, 'guest_count'::text]))) AND ((((definition -> 'conditions'::text) -> 4) IS NULL) OR ((((definition -> 'conditions'::text) -> 4) ->> 'field'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['event_type'::text, 'booking_source'::text, 'answer'::text, 'location_kind'::text, 'guest_count'::text]))))
    ELSE false
END IS TRUE))

CHECK ((
CASE
    WHEN (jsonb_typeof(definition) = 'object'::text) THEN ((definition ?& ARRAY['name'::text, 'scope'::text, 'trigger'::text, 'conditions'::text, 'actions'::text]) AND ((definition - ARRAY['name'::text, 'scope'::text, 'trigger'::text, 'conditions'::text, 'actions'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb))
    ELSE false
END IS TRUE))

CHECK ((
CASE
    WHEN (jsonb_typeof((definition -> 'trigger'::text)) = 'object'::text) THEN
    CASE
        WHEN ((((definition -> 'trigger'::text) ->> 'type'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['booking.created'::text, 'booking.cancelled'::text, 'booking.rescheduled'::text])) AND (((definition -> 'trigger'::text) - ARRAY['type'::text, 'delayMinutes'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND (jsonb_typeof(((definition -> 'trigger'::text) -> 'delayMinutes'::text)) = 'number'::text)) THEN ((((((definition -> 'trigger'::text) ->> 'delayMinutes'::text))::numeric >= (0)::numeric) AND ((((definition -> 'trigger'::text) ->> 'delayMinutes'::text))::numeric <= (43200)::numeric)) AND ((((definition -> 'trigger'::text) ->> 'delayMinutes'::text))::numeric = trunc((((definition -> 'trigger'::text) ->> 'delayMinutes'::text))::numeric)))
        WHEN ((((definition -> 'trigger'::text) ->> 'type'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['before_start'::text, 'after_end'::text])) AND (((definition -> 'trigger'::text) - ARRAY['type'::text, 'offsetMinutes'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND (jsonb_typeof(((definition -> 'trigger'::text) -> 'offsetMinutes'::text)) = 'number'::text)) THEN ((((((definition -> 'trigger'::text) ->> 'offsetMinutes'::text))::numeric >= (5)::numeric) AND ((((definition -> 'trigger'::text) ->> 'offsetMinutes'::text))::numeric <= (43200)::numeric)) AND ((((definition -> 'trigger'::text) ->> 'offsetMinutes'::text))::numeric = trunc((((definition -> 'trigger'::text) ->> 'offsetMinutes'::text))::numeric)))
        ELSE false
    END
    ELSE false
END IS TRUE))
FOREIGN KEY (organization_id, workflow_id) REFERENCES workflow_definitions(organization_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
